about: A full stack developer since 2018, I work on systems where mistakes are expensive: money transfers, top-ups, payments, SaaS platforms shared by many organisations at once.

I evolved payment platforms at ATPS SA in Dakar, then a multi-tenant monitoring & evaluation SaaS platform for DevAlto (Quebec City), fully remote for nearly three years. I now work as an IT consultant.
On the architecture side, I rely on DDD, Clean Architecture and - when the domain calls for it - CQRS and event sourcing, which I also publish as open source.
